items.title: Charles Davis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 23, 1997
items.q: I first came to New York with Clarence Henry.

ctx.x: You had quite an association with Dinah Washington, right?

Yeah, well I worked for her about two, two and a half years. And also, I don’t know if it’s on there, Clarence Henry — speaking of blues — I first came to New York with Clarence Henry. You know, the “Frogman?”
